normalization: float64 mean and population std over existing 894077 training baseline states only; epsilon1e-8; no test fit
threshold_source: medians of same-node history-history event pairs, distinct training queries, both directions; no model decision labels used
primary_population: all same-node directed history->test model-invoked event pairs
cross_node_control: one random different-node donor from SAME historical query for each same-node pair; target position and query distance distribution held fixed
false_skip_rate: P(source Skip | target Keep): model-reference FPR, not ground-truth safety
predictive_comparison: logistic models of agreement using log1p(query distance), log1p(state distance), or both; all fitted on training history-history pairs; evaluated on history-test pairs
intervention: one donor decision substituted at exact target query candidate ordinal+node; identical prefix state checked; fresh MLP thereafter; all unique (target query, target step, donor decision) evaluated once and mapped to donor events
intervention_selection: all same-node pairs and matched cross-node controls; no outcome-based selection; test pairs used for evaluation only
confidence: 500 target-query cluster bootstrap replicates; history fixed; repeated positions/donors not independent
scope_limit: state-only model agreement is partly architectural; retrieval safety assessed separately by actual single-replacement searches; not cumulative reuse or deployed lookup timing
